title: Wallet Concentration Risk
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wallet:balance
| stats latest(balance_usd) as usd by asset
| eventstats sum(usd) as portfolio_usd
| eval pct=round(100*usd/portfolio_usd,1)
| where pct>50
| sort - pct
description: Shows whether one asset has grown to dominate your tracked portfolio, turning a few green weeks into hidden concentration risk.
value: Diversification is easy to believe and hard to verify after price moves; a concentration report gives you the plain answer instantly.
implementation: Forward wallet balances in USD terms; review allocation whenever an asset crosses your comfort threshold.
visualization: Portfolio table of assets by current value and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It logs when one coin or asset has grown so big that too much of your portfolio depends on it.
